facts.anchor: It’s a small black charging cube with one opening for a USB cord.
facts.fact: 露西在插座上发现一个黑色小充电方块，她以为可能是上一个租客留下的。

facts.anchor: returns with Lucy’s new marble bust and bashes the charger—hard.
facts.fact: 萨斯基亚冲进露西卧室拿来新买的大理石半身像，用力把充电器砸碎。

facts.anchor: Babe, this isn’t just a charger. It’s a camera.
facts.fact: 萨斯基亚告诉露西那东西不是充电器而是摄像头。

facts.anchor: It’s illegal to film tenants. He could get in a lot of trouble for this.
facts.fact: 萨斯基亚说明拍摄租客是违法的，罗杰可能因此惹上大麻烦。

facts.anchor: If we went to court, all that would go away.
facts.fact: 萨斯基亚解释若打官司，她低价、包水电的住处就会失去，所以选择私下砸掉。

facts.anchor: you might consider installing a chain or getting one of those rubber doorstops
facts.fact: 萨斯基亚建议露西在前门装防盗链或放橡胶门挡，从内侧阻止他人进入。

facts.anchor: my bedroom door closed, and this morning, when I woke up, it was wide open
facts.fact: 露西告诉萨斯基亚，她昨夜关着卧室门入睡，早上醒来门却大开着、书也散落一地。

facts.anchor: these things are usually hooked up to the cloud through a phone app.
facts.fact: 萨斯基亚说明这类摄像头通常通过手机应用连到云端，砸碎不一定毁掉已存录像。
